mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with joint HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline during FEDFUNDS rising, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% indicates rising inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with joint PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST decline during late-cycle expansion, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
